metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 2001 · The Princess Diaries
metas.description: Mia Thermopolis has just found out that she is the heir apparent to the throne of Genovia. With her friends Lilly and Michael Moscovitz in tow, she tries to navigate through the rest of her sixteenth year.

metas.name: ★ 6.0 · 2004 · A Cinderella Story
metas.description: Routinely exploited by her wicked stepmother, the downtrodden Samantha Montgomery is excited about the prospect of meeting her Internet beau at the school's Halloween dance.

metas.name: ★ 5.9 · 2004 · The Princess Diaries 2: Royal Engagement
metas.description: Now settled in Genovia, Princess Mia faces a new revelation: she is being primed for an arranged marriage to an English suitor.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 1991 · Father of the Bride
metas.description: With his daughter's wedding approaching, a father finds himself reluctant to let her go.

metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 1994 · The Little Rascals
metas.description: Alfalfa is wooing Darla and his "He-Man-Woman-Hating" friends attempt to sabotage the relationship.

metas.name: ★ 4.7 · 1990 · Look Who's Talking Too
metas.description: This time, a new baby is on the way, and it's a girl. Wrapped together with the standard conflict between mother and father, Mikey engages in a bit of sibling rivalry with his new sister.

metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 1995 · Father of the Bride Part II
metas.description: George Banks must deal not only with his daughter's pregnancy, but also with his wife's.

metas.name: ★ 5.6 · 2005 · Kicking & Screaming
metas.description: Family man Phil Weston, a lifelong victim of his father's competitive nature, takes on the coaching duties of a kids' soccer team, and soon realizes that he's also taking on his father's dysfunctional way of relating.

metas.name: ★ 5.9 · 2004 · The Prince and Me
metas.description: At college Paige meets Eddie, a student from Denmark, whom she first dislikes but later accepts, likes, and loves; he proves to be Crown Prince Edvard. Paige follows him to Copenhagen, and he follows her back to school with a plan.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2005 · An Unfinished Life
metas.description: Desperate to provide care for her daughter, down-on-her-luck Jean moves in with her father in-law from whom she is estranged. Through time, they learn to forgive each other and heal old wounds.

metas.name: ★ 5.5 · 2005 · The Perfect Man
metas.description: A lonely mother begins receiving romantic e-mails from a secret admirer, unaware that this perfect man is really a creation of her daughter who is trying to cheer her up.

metas.name: ★ 5.5 · 2005 · Yours, Mine & Ours
metas.description: A widowed Coast Guard Admiral and a widowed handbag designer fall in love and marry, much to the dismay of his 8 and her 10 children.

metas.name: ★ 4.4 · 1993 · Look Who's Talking Now
metas.description: The dogs can talk at a family of 4, where mom loses her job the same day dad gets a job as pilot for a cute, single boss.

metas.name: ★ 5.0 · 1993 · Beethoven's 2nd
metas.description: Beethoven, the St. Bernard dog, becomes a father, but his girlfriend Missy is dognapped, and his puppies are in danger of the same fate.

metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 1995 · It Takes Two
metas.description: Alyssa and Amanda are two little girls who are identical, but complete strangers, that accidentally meet one day.

metas.name: ★ 3.8 · 2000 · The Flintstones in Viva Rock Vegas
metas.description: In this live-action prequel to The Flintstones (1994), the Flintstones and the Rubbles go on a trip to Rock Vegas, where Wilma Slaghoople is pursued by playboy Chip Rockefeller.

metas.name: ★ 5.1 · 2025 · Sunny Sanskari Ki Tulsi Kumari
metas.description: Two former lovers in Delhi try to rekindle old flames, leading to amusing mix-ups and deceptions. As chaos unfolds, a new unexpected romance blooms. Who will find their happy ending amid the confusion.
